name: dsh-session-handoff
description: Session handoff & context management for DeepSeek Harness: structured handoff documents (export/resume/status), active context pruning (acp_* tools + pressure banner), session management (trash/restore/purge), model routes for one model across vendors/plans, and optional OpenViking memory / archify diagram integration.
